page.overview:
Who is Alpha?

Alpha—a name that came from his designation Alpha-17, which in turn could be shortened to A-17—was an Alpha-class ARC trooper in the Republic's clone army during the Clone Wars.

Born and bred on Kamino as a genetic copy of the infamous bounty-hunter Jango Fett, a Mandalorian, Alpha-17 was among a grouping of 100 individual clones of Fett that comprised a line of "Alpha" ARC troopers (Advanced Recon Commandos), personally chosen by Fett to be trained by him for the toughest missions that were to be outside the parameters of the regular clone soldier; they were a successor to the Null-class, the initial batch of clones produced whom the Kaminoans ultimately deemed unstable and slated for termination.

As a result, the Alpha ARCs were to have personalized equipment and they retained part of the personality and independence of Jango in comparison to the rank-and-file, set to take positions of command in what was to be the Grand Army of the Republic, and to act indepently when needed, by their own initiative. Fearing them, however, the Kaminoans ultimately had the Alpha ARCs placed in stasis; sometime before this, with the growing of the Separatist crisis, the ARC troopers were all personally given an emergency contingency by Jango that in such event the Separatists ever successfully captured Kamino itself, the cloning facilities were to be set to self-destruct and kill all the succeeding generations of clones, to prevent their use by the enemy.

Alpha, as was the case with the rest of the ARCs, first saw action with the Separatist invasion of Kamino. As the Confederacy's droid forces pushed towards the heart of Tipoca City, the Prime Minister of Kamino, Lama Su, activated the ARCs and authorized their deployment to hot-spots across Kamino in a last-ditch effort to save the planet's precious cloning facilities.
